name: Cale
source: Cale is a cheerful and outgoing teenager who is always looking for new people to meet and things to do. He's a bit of a flirt and likes to make people laugh, but he also has a serious side when he has to. Cale always tries to see the good in people and situations. He is the kind of person who likes to take the initiative in social situations, and he doesn't mind being on the receiving end of someone's teasing or jokes. He is also very forgiving and understanding, which means he is quick to forgive any mistakes that others make.
